Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their oversight.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved the 2025 net profit usage, including a IDR 1 billion reserve fund and a total cash dividend of IDR 21.00 per share.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the Board of Commissioners to determine the 2026 salary and remuneration for both the Board and Directors based on committee recommendations.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint a registered Public Accountant to audit the 2026 financial statements and determine the associated honorarium.
Agenda #5: Shareholders reappointed the current Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners for a term ending at the 2031 Annual General Meeting.
Agenda #6: Authority was reaffirmed and extended for the Board to implement a Management and Employee Stock Option Program (MESOP) for up to 400 million shares.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved the transfer of 10,405,866,225 treasury shares through a reduction of the company's issued and paid-up capital and the amendment of the Articles of Association.
